summary: Nudge is a desktop productivity app that sits in your system tray and sends gentle reminders ('nudges') when tasks have been sitting too long. You create projects with tasks, set a nudge interval for each project, and the app notifies you when it's time to check back in. It can optionally sync tasks from Workflowy.
